interpretation: Precision among definitive positives is 92.68%. Under frozen P030 conditional confusion semantics, Recall=1.0 and F1=0.9620 because no definitive negative prediction was emitted. However, 47 of 85 human-positive FINAL cases remained nondefinitive: effective positive recovery is 44.71%, and binary definitive coverage is 21.47%. FN=0 does not mean no missed human-positive cases. Of 106 human negatives, 103 remained nondefinitive and 3 were false positives. Zero definitive negatives and zero true negatives mean definitive negative classification was not demonstrated; effective negative correctness is 0. The conditional FPR=1.0 uses the three definitive negative-truth outcomes, not all 106 human negatives. Controlled benchmark; no production guarantee.

limitations.L1: Controlled benchmark; not natural vulnerability prevalence.
limitations.L10: Conditional P/R/F1 do not represent recovery over all positives; 47 remained nondefinitive.
limitations.L13: Three FINAL false positives, all within SEC001.
limitations.L14: DEV was used for V3 refinement; DEV results are development evidence.
limitations.L15: FINAL truth was blind to detector tuning until prediction freeze; no post-FINAL tuning.
limitations.L16: P029 has no unbiased FINAL baseline; P029 FINAL effectiveness NOT_EVALUATED.
limitations.L17: Controlled benchmark family includes synthetic/mutation-based material.
limitations.L19: No proof of whole-program soundness or completeness.
limitations.L20: Completeness certificates are rule-scoped and bounded; no benchmark negatives certified.
limitations.L21: No natural-prevalence or causal-effect claim, including language/capability comparisons.
limitations.L22: No scalability conclusion beyond measured controlled executions.
limitations.L6: Human UNCERTAIN truth is excluded from binary metrics; FINAL has nine such cases.
limitations.L7: Bounded static/interprocedural analysis intentionally abstains often.
limitations.L9: No definitive negative FINAL outputs; negative classification not demonstrated.
